howToUse: For each suite: load `flags` and `segments` exactly as GET /server/v2/flags returns them, evaluate each case (flagKey + context) with your SDK engine, and compare enabled, value (deep equality), variant and reason with `expected`. For hashVectors: bucket(flagKey, salt, purpose, id) must equal `bucket`.

suites.name: basics
suites.description: Off, on, off value, missing flag in payload, context fields winning over attributes (§6.3, §6.4).

cases.name: disabled string flag serves its offValue
null offValue is served as false
on, no rules, 100% rollout: true without any id
attribute named userId is ignored; context.userId wins
context.userId used for the userId attribute
